name: checksum_algorithm_implementation
title: Checksum Algorithm Implementation
summary: Provides implementations of standard checksum algorithms like Luhn, Verhoeff, and ISO 7064, used to validate identification numbers.

tools.name: calculate_luhn_checksum
tools.description: Calculates the Luhn checksum for a given number and an optional alphabet. A valid number should have a checksum of 0.

params.name: number
params.description: The number or string to calculate the Luhn checksum for.

params.name: alphabet
params.description: The alphabet used for the checksum calculation. Defaults to '0123456789'.

returns.name: is_valid
returns.description: True if the checksum is 0, indicating a valid number according to the Luhn algorithm.

returns.name: display_result
returns.description: A human-readable summary of the result, e.g., 'Valid (checksum: 0)' or 'Invalid (checksum: 5)'.

tools.implementation_notes: Call stdnum.luhn.checksum(number=number, alphabet=alphabet). The result is an integer. To determine if the number is valid, check if the result is 0.

tools.name: calculate_verhoeff_checksum
tools.description: Calculates the Verhoeff checksum for a given number. A valid number should have a checksum of 0.

params.name: number
params.description: The number or string to calculate the Verhoeff checksum for.

returns.name: is_valid
returns.description: True if the checksum is 0, indicating a valid number according to the Verhoeff algorithm.

returns.name: display_result
returns.description: A human-readable summary of the result, e.g., 'Valid (checksum: 0)' or 'Invalid (checksum: 5)'.

tools.implementation_notes: Call stdnum.verhoeff.checksum(number=number). The result is an integer. To determine if the number is valid, check if the result is 0.

tools.name: calculate_iso7064_mod_97_10_checksum
tools.description: Calculates the ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 checksum. A valid number should have a checksum of 1.

params.name: number
params.description: The number or string to calculate the ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 checksum for.

returns.name: checksum_value
returns.description: The calculated ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 checksum value.

returns.name: is_valid
returns.description: True if the checksum is 1, indicating a valid number according to the ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 algorithm.

returns.name: display_result
returns.description: A human-readable summary of the result, e.g., 'Valid (checksum: 1)' or 'Invalid (checksum: 42)'.

tools.implementation_notes: Call stdnum.iso7064.mod_97_10.checksum(number=number). The result is an integer. To determine if the number is valid, check if the result is 1.

tools.name: calculate_iso7064_mod_37_2_checksum
tools.description: Calculates the ISO 7064 Mod 37, 2 checksum. This algorithm can be used for alphanumeric numbers. A valid number should have a checksum of 1.

params.name: number
params.description: The number or string to calculate the ISO 7064 Mod 37, 2 checksum for.

params.name: name
params.description: The alphabet used for the checksum calculation. Defaults to '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ*'.

returns.name: checksum_value
returns.description: The calculated ISO 7064 Mod 37, 2 checksum value.

returns.name: is_valid
returns.description: True if the checksum is 1, indicating a valid number according to the ISO 7064 Mod 37, 2 algorithm.

returns.name: display_result
returns.description: A human-readable summary of the result, e.g., 'Valid (checksum: 1)' or 'Invalid (checksum: 12)'.

tools.implementation_notes: Call stdnum.iso7064.mod_37_2.checksum(number=number, alphabet=alphabet). The result is an integer. To determine if the number is valid, check if the result is 1.

uncertainties: The exact validity check (checksum == 0 or checksum == 1) depends on the specific ISO 7064 variant used.
